name: tileforge-studio
tileforgeReleaseNotes: Tools & tasks helps beginners choose a goal and opens the appropriate tool.
Actionable next steps, friendlier map-setting names and clearer doorway labels.
Ten active draft slots with atomic saving/restoration limits, a usage counter and clear full-slot guidance.
Existing drafts can still save at capacity; no drafts are deleted automatically.
Small source sprite pictures in NPC/event menus, appearance choices and NPC summaries, including supported custom graphics.
